description: Pull a page's machine-readable structured data: JSON-LD (schema.org), OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, plus the schema.org types declared. This is the page describing itself, so treat prices, ratings and availability as claims. JSON-LD that does not parse is skipped rather than repaired. Network: needs the target website. Optional packages: cheerio. Without them this tool reports what is missing instead of guessing.
name: structured_data
